about.title: About us
about.description1: We build digital systems that bring in customers: websites, search visibility, ads, tracking and automation. Each part is built to work with the others, so nothing is done just for show.
about.description2: We start by understanding your business, then build only what makes a difference. Clear scope, solid work and results you can measure.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Send us a message. We'll set up a short, free call to understand your business and see if we're a good fit.

items.question: Can I hire you for just one thing?
items.answer: Yes. A website, ads or anything else on its own is fine.

items.question: How is pricing set?
items.answer: Per project, based on scope. You get a clear proposal first, and nothing is charged until you've approved it.

items.question: Do you work remotely?
items.answer: Yes. We work with clients across Europe and Latin America, fully remote.

items.question: Who owns the website and data?
items.answer: Your domain, content and customer data are always yours. We host and maintain the site for you, so you don't have to deal with the technical side.

cta.description: Have a project in mind? Let's talk.

steps.title: Talk
steps.description: A free, no-obligation call to understand your business, your customers and what's holding growth back. No sales pitch, just questions.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: We define what you need, and nothing more. You get a clear proposal with scope, timeline and price, and you pay nothing until you've approved it.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We design and build it: fast, reliable and easy to use. You see progress along the way and give feedback before launch.

steps.title: Improve

areas.title: Websites
areas.body: Company websites that explain what you do and make it easy to get in touch. Fast, clear and built to show up on Google. You can update texts and images yourself, or let us handle it.

areas.title: Online stores
areas.body: Webshops for selling your products online, with payments, shipping and order handling set up from day one. Designed so customers find what they want and check out without friction.

areas.title: Web apps and internal tools
areas.body: Custom software that runs in the browser: booking systems, customer portals, dashboards or staff tools. When off-the-shelf software doesn't fit how you work, we build what does.

benefitsList: Higher rankings for what you offer

areas.title: Technical SEO
areas.body: We fix what stops Google from understanding your site: speed, structure, mobile issues and indexing. It's the foundation everything else builds on.

areas.title: Local visibility
areas.body: We set up and optimise your Google Business Profile and local listings, so you show up on Maps and in “near me” searches, right where customers decide.

areas.title: Content that ranks
areas.body: We find the words your customers actually search for and shape your pages around them. Clear, useful content that ranks and turns visitors into enquiries.

areas.title: Google Ads
areas.body: Ads on Google that appear when people search for exactly what you offer. You pay for clicks from people who are already looking to buy.

areas.title: Social ads
areas.body: Campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and LinkedIn that reach the right audience, plus retargeting for people who visited but didn't get in touch.

areas.title: Tracking and optimisation
areas.body: Every campaign is tracked from click to enquiry. We cut what doesn't work and put more budget behind what does.

areas.title: Tracking setup
areas.body: We set up Google Analytics and conversion tracking properly, so you can see where visitors come from and what makes them get in touch.

areas.title: Dashboards and reports
areas.body: One simple dashboard with the numbers that matter, and regular reports in plain language. No digging through endless charts.

areas.title: Privacy built in
areas.body: Cookie consent and tracking set up to follow GDPR, so you collect useful data without risking fines or your customers' trust.

areas.title: Workflow automation
areas.body: We automate repetitive tasks like moving leads into your CRM, sending follow-ups or creating invoices. Less copy-paste, fewer mistakes.

areas.title: AI chatbots
areas.body: A chatbot trained on your business that answers common questions, qualifies leads and books meetings, around the clock.

areas.title: AI assistants and integrations
areas.body: AI tools that help with content and campaigns, and integrations that connect the systems you already use, so data flows without manual work.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we collect through this website, why we collect it, and what rights you have.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: Brehaut Consulting is the data controller for the processing described here. If you have questions about your personal data, email contact@brehautconsulting.com.

sections.heading: The contact form
paragraphs: When you send the contact form we receive your name, email address, phone number, company, website (if you add it), the services you select and your message.

We use this only to reply to your enquiry and, if we decide to work together, to prepare a proposal. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.

The form is delivered to our inbox as an email through Amazon Web Services (Amazon SES). It is not stored in a database on the website. We keep the correspondence as long as needed to handle your enquiry. If it does not lead to an assignment, we delete it within 12 months.

sections.heading: Spam protection
paragraphs: To stop automated spam, the form limits how many messages can be sent in a short time. For this we store a one-way hashed (pseudonymised) version of your IP address for at most 24 hours. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in keeping the form secure.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The website works without cookies. Only if you accept in the cookie banner do we load Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, which set cookies to measure visits, for example which pages are viewed and whether the contact form is sent. If you decline, nothing is loaded. The legal basis is your consent.
Your choice is saved in your browser so we don't ask again. You can change it at any time via "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.

sections.heading: Hosting
paragraphs: The website is hosted by Netlify. Like any web server, Netlify processes technical data such as your IP address and browser type to deliver the pages and protect against attacks.

sections.heading: Who we share data with
paragraphs: We only share personal data with service providers that process it on our behalf: Netlify (hosting), Amazon Web Services (email delivery), our email provider and, only with your consent, Google (analytics). We never sell personal data.
Some of these providers are based in the USA. Such transfers are protected by the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability, and to withdraw your consent at any time. Email contact@brehautconsulting.com and we will reply within one month.
If you think we handle your data incorrectly, you can complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY) at imy.se.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
